_comment: Per-language labels for human-readable strings inside structured data. Used by scripts/seo.mjs when it localises JSON-LD on the translated pages. Page-level name/description are taken from scripts/seo-data.json instead, because they must match the page title exactly. Brand names (Phisoft, product names) are deliberately absent so they pass through.
